modified_caption: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of 1.1K tasks across three primary categories and nine subcategories, with balanced sample sizes across capabilities. The central categories include 'Context Retrieving' (dark green), 'Context Tracking' (dark blue), and 'Contradiction Resolution' (dark red). Among the subcategories, 'Multitasking' has the highest value at 180, followed by 'Privacy Protection' at 121. Notably, 'Recursive Reasoning' demonstrates a consistent upward trend in its value compared to other subcategories. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative importance of each capability, with 'Dynamic Instruction' and 'Memorization' showing the lowest values at 90 each, indicating their lesser emphasis in the dataset.
